description: This file defines the NumberHelperService class within the OrangeHRM project, providing methods for number formatting with or without grouped thousands, intended for use as a service within the application.

classes.name: NumberHelperService
classes.description: A service class that offers methods for formatting numbers, including basic formatting and formatting with grouped thousands.

methods.name: numberFormat
methods.description: Formats a floating-point number with specified decimal places, using a period as decimal separator and no thousands separator.

methods.name: numberFormatWithGroupedThousands
methods.description: Formats a floating-point number with specified decimal places and an optional thousands separator, defaulting to a comma.
